title: Data Interpretation & Visualisation
intent: formative · Research & Retrieval (Doing) · click through the process
statement: Convert raw numbers or qualitative material into a meaningful, honest narrative — with the right picture.

steps.title: Clean and check the data
steps.text: Fix errors, note what is missing, and understand how the data was produced.

steps.title: Choose the right summary or visual
steps.text: Match the chart to the question — the picture should reveal the pattern, not decorate it.

steps.title: Read the pattern
steps.text: Say what the data shows plainly, distinguishing the signal from the noise.

steps.title: State the uncertainty
steps.text: Report the limits — variation, sample size, what the data cannot tell you.

steps.title: Turn it into a narrative
steps.text: Explain what it means for the question, not just what the numbers are.

feedForward.text: For one result, write the single sentence it supports — and one sentence on what it does NOT prove.
